important_instructions: Incomplete applications, and applications sent without the full set of required documents, will be rejected. Candidates who apply will not be allowed to withdraw their candidature later. Once selected, the officer will not be allowed to withdraw the name or refuse to join; the sponsoring authority must relieve the officer within one month of the appointment letter/order. Officers already on deputation must have their application forwarded by the parent cadre/department with cadre clearance, vigilance clearance and integrity certificate. The information on qualification and experience in the bio-data, supported by documents, will be evaluated by the Selection Committee at the time of selection. Terms printed with the Senior Architect circular: Dearness Allowance in addition to pay; Special Compensatory Allowance and Island Special Allowance as per rules; rent-free unfurnished accommodation as per general review from time to time; free sea passage once a year for self and family members when going on or returning from leave; deputation allowance as admissible under rules. Tenure (Senior Architect terms): initially 03 (three) years, which may be extended as per rules if required. The selected officer may opt for pay in the deputation post, or pay of the parent post plus deputation allowance as per Ministry of Finance orders. The selected officer will be governed by the rules and orders applicable to government servants of that category working under the Andaman and Nicobar Administration.

content_sections.heading: About APWD Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Andaman Public Works Department works under the Andaman and Nicobar Administration, with the Office of the Chief Engineer at Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram. The Deputy Secretary (PWD), Andaman and Nicobar Administration Secretariat, issued the two Hindi vacancy circulars dated 11/12 November 2026 and sent them to the Chief Engineer on 20 November 2026 for upload on the departmental website. The Senior Architect circular carries File No. 2-65(A)/2026-PWD/753.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application, with the bio-data in two copies and the enclosures, must be forwarded by the employer and must reach this office within 60 days from the date of publication of the vacancy circular: Office of the Chief Engineer, Andaman Public Works Department, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, PIN-744101 Obtain the application form (bio-data proforma, Annexure-I) from the Office of the Chief Engineer at the address above, or download it from the Andaman and Nicobar Administration website ( https://andamannicobar.gov.in ) or the APWD website ( https://apwd.and.nic.in ). Fill in the bio-data in two copies and sign it. Attach the documents listed under Enclosures. Submit it to your employer, who must forward it through proper channel with the certification printed at the end of the form. Make sure the forwarded application reaches the Office of the Chief Engineer within 60 days of publication of the circular. The application and bio-data must show: name, address, date of birth, educational qualification, details of present employment, post currently held, present pay scale, present pay, details of experience, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, details of penalties (major/minor) imposed, if any, and the dossier of Annual Confidential Reports of the last five years. Only eligible candidates who can be relieved immediately on selection should apply. The notice does not mention a postal mode or what to write on the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Both posts are in the General Central Service, Group 'A', Gazetted (Non-Ministerial). For both posts the maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (ISTC) is not more than 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications. The notice prints no age relaxation. Who can apply: officers under the Central Government, State Government, UT Administration, Public Sector Undertakings, universities, recognised research institutes, semi-government or autonomous bodies or statutory organisations who: (a)(i) hold an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre/department; or (ii) have five years' service in the grade after regular appointment to a post in Pay Band-3 Rs 15600-39100 with Grade Pay Rs 7600 or equivalent; or (iii) have ten years' service in the grade after regular appointment to a post in Pay Band-3 Rs 15600-39100 with Grade Pay Rs 6600 or equivalent; and (b) possess the essential qualification and experience below. Essential: Degree in Architecture from a recognised University/Institute. 11 years' experience in Government organisations/departments/Public Sector Undertakings/State Government/UT Administration/autonomous institutions. Registered with the Council of Architecture. Desirable: Master's degree in Architecture from a recognised university, or degree or diploma in Town/City/Urban/Regional Planning. One year experience in works related to town planning/civic designing/building control regulations. Fellowship of the Indian Institute of Architects or membership of any professional institute. Six-month certificate/diploma course in AutoCAD, ArchiCAD, Revit. Departmental candidates in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion will not be eligible for appointment on deputation; similarly, officers appointed on deputation will not be eligible for appointment by promotion. The period of deputation (ISTC), including any immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation in the same or another organisation/department of the Central Government, shall ordinarily not exceed five years. For deputation, regular service before 01.01.2006 will be treated as service in the corresponding grade pay/pay scale extended on the 6th Central Pay Commission recommendations, except where several pre-revised scales were merged into one grade. Who can apply: officers under the Central Government, State Government, UT Administration, autonomous or statutory organisations, Public Sector Undertakings, or recognised universities/institutes/research institutes who: (a)(i) hold an analogous post on a regular basis in the parent cadre/department; or (ii) have five years' service in the grade after regular appointment to a post at Pay Level-9 or Pay Level-10 of the pay matrix or equivalent; and (b) possess the qualification and experience below. Bachelor's degree in Architecture from a recognised University/Institute. One year experience in works related to town planning/civic designing/building control regulations. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The Senior Architect circular lists these documents to attach: Bio-data in the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I), in two copies, duly signed by the officer and forwarded through proper channel. Vigilance clearance certificate. Integrity certificate. Details of penalty (major/minor), if any imposed. Dossier of Annual Confidential Reports of the last five years – every page of the APAR/ACR copies must be attested by an Under Secretary or an officer of equivalent rank. Where the applicant's organisation does not follow Central Government pay scales, the latest pay slip showing basic pay with pay scale and increment rate, DA/interim relief/other allowances separately, and total emoluments (form item 15). The employer's certificate at the end of the form confirms that no vigilance or disciplinary case is pending, that integrity is certified, that the ACR dossier or attested ACR copies of the last 05 years are attached, and that no major/minor penalty was imposed in the last 10 years (or lists the penalties).

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in APWD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 posts: one Senior Architect and one Architect in the Andaman Public Works Department, Andaman and Nicobar Administration.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for APWD Senior Architect and Architect applications?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Sri Vijaya Puram within 60 days from the date of publication of the circular – about 26 January 2027 (60 days from 27 November 2026).

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the APWD Senior Architect post?
faq.answer: A degree in Architecture from a recognised University/Institute, 11 years' experience in Government organisations, PSUs, State Government, UT Administration or autonomous institutions, and registration with the Council of Architecture, along with the parent-cadre post or service conditions.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the APWD Architect post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's degree in Architecture, one year experience in town planning/civic designing/building control regulations work, fellowship or membership of the Indian Institute of Architects, and a certificate/diploma in AutoCAD, ArchiCAD, Revit or similar software.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for APWD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment by deputation (ISTC) is not more than 56 years as on the closing date for receipt of applications, for both posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of APWD Senior Architect and Architect?
faq.answer: Senior Architect is in Pay Level-13 (Rs.123100-215900) and Architect in Pay Level-11 (Rs. 67700-208700); the selected officer may instead opt for parent-post pay plus deputation allowance.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for APWD Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill the Annexure-I bio-data proforma in two copies, attach vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, penalty details and the last five years' ACR dossier, and get it forwarded by your employer to the Office of the Chief Engineer, APWD, Nirman Bhawan, Sri Vijaya Puram, PIN-744101.

faq.question: Q8. For how long is the APWD deputation?
faq.answer: Senior Architect is for 03 years and Architect for 02 years on deputation (ISTC); the Senior Architect tenure may be extended as per rules if required.

faq.question: Q9. What allowances come with the APWD deputation posts?
faq.answer: The terms list Dearness Allowance, Special Compensatory Allowance and Island Special Allowance as per rules, rent-free unfurnished accommodation, free sea passage once a year for self and family on leave, and admissible deputation allowance.

faq.question: Q10. Can departmental officers in the feeder grade apply for Senior Architect?
faq.answer: No. Departmental candidates in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for appointment on deputation to the Senior Architect post.
